Rule 2, component-local objects: any other recurring cluster is a final value object with public readonly fields beside the class that uses it; a public method with 4 or more parameters, or 3 parameters and a body of 12 lines or more, takes one operation object named after the operation (ExportRequest, MergeInstruction, TransitionCommand), never after the method or class, and it may have one user; mostly-optional parameters become the required ones plus one typed `<Operation>Options` class with named fields and defaults. Rule 3, run objects: when 3 or more private helpers share the same 2 or more parameters, the entry point builds an `<Operation>Run` (model: CascadeRun in lib/Service/Object/SaveObject.php) and the helpers take the run plus at most one more parameter; a run never leaves the class that built it. Confirm before your first change with `git fetch origin main && for f in lib/Db/RegisterSchema.php lib/Db/ListQuery.php lib/Db/SchemaCatalog.php lib/Db/SchemaCatalogInterface.php lib/Kernel/Contracts/ObjectRef.php lib/Kernel/Contracts/RegisterSchemaRef.php; do git cat-file -e origin/main:$f && echo ok $f || echo MISSING $f; done`.
